cohort: 399 clouds of metalcytotox_5metal_multitask_v3.csv, split=train, metal_placement=bonded (the CSV/ETKDG path)
purpose: Confirm the bond graph the head is trained on has no silently-overwritten pair labels, and record its class balance.

measured.note_duplicate_dative: A covalent M-L bond (bo=1.0, class SINGLE, is_dative=False) and a synthetic dative edge (bo=0.5, class SINGLE, is_dative=True) carry the SAME class, so a duplicate pair would not appear as a label conflict. It would only show as a doubled pair count. The metal is a disconnected fragment in the reconstructed SMILES, so no RDKit bond touches it and the duplicate cannot arise; edges_at_metal == dative_flags_true confirms it.

findings: 0 conflicting pair labels in 399 clouds: the dense truth table's last-write-wins symmetry never discards a label.

68.4% of directed bond labels are AROMATIC (18,030/26,344); SINGLE 7,390, DOUBLE 912, TRIPLE 12, and 0 BOND_NO_BOND edges (the cloud carries only true bonds, negatives come from the radius-graph candidates).
edges_at_metal (1,038 directed) equals dative_flags_true exactly, so no dative edge duplicates a covalent RDKit bond — the metal is a disconnected fragment in the reconstructed SMILES.
metal_atom_index agrees with the coordinate frame in 399/399 clouds.
honest_limits: A covalent M-L bond and a synthetic dative edge both carry class SINGLE, so a duplicate pair would not show as a label conflict; it is excluded here by construction (the metal has no RDKit bonds), not by the conflict check.
Measured on the CSV path. The tmQM path is measured separately (wfa113_t66_tmqm_cohort.json).
